meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: Claude 会把项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周拆成单周文件，再逐周生成一章叙事摘要；每周的 subagent 都会收到上一周的 carry-forward 块，让故事前后连贯。产出写入 docs/timeline-weeks/，章数等于时间线覆盖的 ISO 周数。
howto.when: 当你要求“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline”等，或想让项目历史按周续写叙事章节时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行，且项目至少有一周观察数据。

howto.what_en: Claude splits a project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then writes one narrative chapter per week; each week's subagent gets the prior week's carry-forward block so the story stays continuous. Output goes to docs/timeline-weeks/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline" or week-by-week story chapters. Needs a running claude-mem worker and at least one ISO week of observations.
